method: behavioural experiment, preliminary 2022 results reported in a review; value stated as a lower bound ('at least')
conditions: lower bound; the review calls the experiment preliminary and cites an unpublished 2022 presentation by its own authors

source.title: An Overview of the Penguin Visual System

where: Section 3.1.9 (Retina), one sentence; quote is its first two consecutive pieces (words 1 to 33), the sentence continues 'which, accounting for the uncertainty in that experiment, provides some reassurance that these estimates of visual acuity are of the right magnitude'

note: Review reports a preliminary, unpublished behavioural result; the primary source (reference 97) was not opened. Value is a minimum, not a point estimate.
